purpose: This table is a small reference dataset mapping two-letter airline carrier codes to their full legal airline names, intended to be joined against flight-level fact tables that record carrier codes.
usage: Consumers should join on the carrier column to enrich any fact table that records a two-letter carrier code with the full airline name; both carrier and name are required and fully populated so no null handling is needed by downstream consumers.
limitations: The profile shows no duplicate rows (duplicate_row_rate 0.0) and no nulls in either business column, so cleanup was limited to dropping the three Airbyte capture-metadata columns; the dataset is static at 16 rows as profiled and does not capture historical renames or mergers of carriers.
